'''Ardot''' was a [[Gender/Legends|male]] [[Human/Legends|Human]] [[Infantry/Legends|infantry]] [[Commanding officer/Legends|commander]] of the [[Sith Empire (Post–Great Hyperspace War)|reconstituted Sith Empire's]] forces at the [[Jedi Temple (Ilum)|Ilum Jedi Temple]] during the [[Galactic War]]. Stationed before the Temple's [[Ray shield/Legends|ray shield]]-protected entrance at the [[Battle of Ilum]] in [[3640 BBY]], he was killed by [[Galactic Republic/Legends|Galactic Republic]] forces that laid siege to the Imperial occupants of the [[Jedi/Legends|Jedi]] Temple from [[Ilum/Legends|Ilum's]] [[Eastern Ice Shelf]]. At the [[Time/Legends|time]], Ardot wielded a large broad-bladed [[Vibrosword/Legends|vibrosword]] in each hand.<ref name="SWTOR" />

==Behind the scenes==
Infantry Commander Ardot appears in the [[Star Wars video games|video game]] ''[[Star Wars: The Old Republic]]'' as a Champion-difficulty NPC on Ilum. Though not involved in any quests, killing him is required to complete a Republic-side achievement.
